announcements.headline: Annual Financial Report
announcements.insight: Wheatley Group Capital PLC has published its Annual Financial Report. This follows the completion of an Annual Review with S&P in June and a Directorate change in September.

announcements.headline: Directorate change
announcements.insight: Wheatley Group Capital PLC has announced a directorate change. This follows its recent completion of an Annual Review with S&P.

announcements.headline: Wheatley Group completes Annual Review with S&P
announcements.insight: Wheatley Group Capital PLC has completed its annual review with S&P. Shareholders should monitor for any resulting changes to credit ratings or associated financing implications.
